cards.title: Your notes, fixed
cards.text: Fewer enemies, waves you see coming, dash safety, Power and Duration, new cards, shards, new rooms.
cards.why: Everything from your stage 3 notes except breakable walls, which come with camps. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details:
Version 0.5.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

All numbers are first guesses; say 'more' or 'less' on any part.

parts.title: Crowd and waves
parts.text: 5 enemies at the start, a few more each minute. Waves at 0:30, then every 45 s, warned 10 s ahead by a red bar on the screen edge they come from and a countdown. Wave 1 from one side, then two, later sometimes three.

parts.title: Dash safety
parts.text: Nothing can touch you during a dash or for 0.35 s after it. A pale ring shows while you're safe.

parts.title: Power and Duration
parts.text: New cards for you: Power is +15% damage from everything. Duration is +15% bolt range, spawn life and dash length.

parts.title: Level-ups
parts.text: 3 cards, not 4, coming quicker. Bigger steps: health +25, speed +8%, cooldowns 10%.

parts.title: New modules
parts.text: Runs start with a pick of 3. The first level-up and every 3rd after (levels 2, 5, 8) offer new modules, each already on a cast.

parts.title: Spawns
parts.text: 90 health (was 40), draining over 16 s so hits shorten their life. They hit softer and bump off each other.

parts.title: Cards and build
parts.text: New look: a rarity band, an icon, level pips. The build shows a column per cast with empty slots.

parts.title: Shards
parts.text: Chests are now shards: a gold crystal standing in dead ends and rooms. Same as before inside.

parts.title: Rooms
parts.text: 8 rooms, bigger: square, round, L, cross and pillared. Most have 2 ways in, big ones 3. Rooms tinted, shards gold, you white.
